extracted.intended_audience: Readers and reviewers on Royal Road (site members, including authors who review others)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and guidelines for leaving ratings and reviews on Royal Road, including what each review type requires, content and spoiler limits, conduct expectations, anti-manipulation rules, and review-swap requirements. Intended to govern how readers evaluate and comment on web fiction hosted on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews aim to inform prospective readers if the story is something they will want to read.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do this by communicating how well a story delivers what was promised in the premise (synopsis and opening chapters), judging how well the story is written (grammar and prose), and highlighting the highs and lows of your experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verifying review validity & sorting
rubrics_metrics.description: You can verify the validity of a review by checking the reading history of the reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reviews are sorted by 'Top', you will find reviews by people with similar reading taste. Logged-out users get random sorting. Upvotes and downvotes exist but are currently only feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Levels of feedback (Ratings, Basic Reviews, Advanced Reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you read the story, there are three levels of feedback you can leave: Ratings (0.5–5 star scores, no written feedback required), Basic Reviews (overall 0.5–5 star plus brief overview/justification), and Advanced Reviews (overall score plus subcategory scores).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advanced reviews require detailed coverage of the subcategories: Style, Story, Grammar, and Characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style (advanced review subcategory)
rubrics_metrics.description: Style: The general feeling of the piece as created by the author's word choice, literary devices, and unique way of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rate how the author's voice, diction, and techniques contribute to the reading experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story (advanced review subcategory)
rubrics_metrics.description: Story: Plot development and pacing (i.e., how well a story is put together).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge structure, plotting, pacing, and how coherently the narrative unfolds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar (advanced review subcategory)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grammar: The technical aspects of the writing, including spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate mechanics and technical presentation separate from style and story content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characters (advanced review subcategory)
rubrics_metrics.description: Character: The characters in the story, how well they are depicted, how realistic and three-dimensional they are.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to both main and side characters; judge characterization, development, and believability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justify the rating
rubrics_metrics.description: The Review needs to justify the rating, regardless of how high or low the score is.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An advanced review must write a detailed review that covers the subcategories being rated (Style, Story, Grammar, and Characters) and justify the overall score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay on topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Your review should address the story itself, and only the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not write about unrelated content such as the author's activities, other people, other reviews, etc. Reviews and ratings may not be based solely on superficial information (cover, synopsis, tags, title, popularity, ranking). You may mention genre/tags sparingly (e.g., how elements of genre were poorly done) but not as the main focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: No plagiarism accusations in reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Accusing an author of plagiarism in reviews is forbidden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a story violates Royal Road terms (e.g., plagiarism), report it via the report system or DMCA link rather than alleging it in a review.

rubrics_metrics.name: No discouraging comparisons to other works
rubrics_metrics.description: Don’t discourage readers from reading a story by comparing it to another similar story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comparative reviews that aim to dissuade readers by unfavorable comparisons may be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be fair and respectful
rubrics_metrics.description: Directly insulting the author or the readers is strictly forbidden. You may criticize the writing in constructive ways if you have a genuine desire to help, but do not direct the feedback at an author personally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discouraging an author from writing is taboo. Do not intentionally depict a story as something it is not (e.g., claim it contains acts it doesn't). Avoid personal attacks; focus criticism on the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: No incitement of harmful acts
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not instigate or incite any harmful acts in the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews must not encourage illegal or harmful behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate language
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews can’t contain profanity, vulgarity, sexual content, or descriptions of gore.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes vivid descriptions of sexual acts, torture, violence, and other graphic/gore content. Slander and discrimination are forbidden (attacks on ethnic, religious, political, sexual orientation, gender or racially discriminatory content can result in banning).

rubrics_metrics.name: Spoiler policy
rubrics_metrics.description: A review may contain spoilers under the appropriate spoiler tag.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spoiler content may not exceed one-third of the overall word count. Discussing spoilers cannot be the focus of a review. Spoilers can't be the majority of the plot summarized into points, nor mention major revelations (e.g., a character's death or major success/failure). Quoted content must still comply with review rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: No meaningless/inflated content or spam
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews must not contain meaningless characters and words used to inflate character count or review length, and must not contain spam.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews should be substantive and relevant; avoid filler or manipulative padding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of review
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews must be written in English or in the language the fiction is written in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the fiction's language unless otherwise appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ranking manipulation prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Offering to release chapters based on scores of reviews and ratings is considered ranking manipulation and is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attempts to manipulate ratings (including review/ratings swaps promising favorable scores) will be treated as manipulation and are banned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-account rule / multi-account prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Rating and reviewing from multiple accounts is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site has systems to detect multi-account manipulation; violators will be sanctioned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household/friends disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Members of the same household or friends may review the story as long as they clearly state their relation to the author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency about relationships is required to avoid undisclosed bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sanctions for repeated or coordinated abuse
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated breaking of the rules will result in permanent sanctions or banning of your account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attempts to manipulate the ratings or the review system with a group will result in having all the reviews removed; participating users will be scrutinized and may face additional disciplinary actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review swaps: allowed but regulated
rubrics_metrics.description: Review swaps are allowed, but rating and review swaps promising high scores are prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you agree to a review swap, you are expected to actually read the other person's fiction and write a thoughtful review with a rating that matches your opinion. Agreeing beforehand to high scores is vote manipulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review swap: must use advanced review
rubrics_metrics.description: The review swap must be an advanced review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Swaps must include detailed subcategory ratings and proper justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review swap: minimum reading requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Both users must read at least 10,000 words (approximately 36 pages) of the other person's fiction before writing the review, unless the story in question is a completed short story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This ensures reviews are based on substantive reading rather than cursory skimming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review swap: justify rating and disclosure sign
rubrics_metrics.description: The review must justify the rating. When participating in a review swap, the reviewer receives a small indicator signifying this.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sign does not affect the score; concealing the sign is considered manipulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to report reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: If you see any reviews that violate the rules above, report them by clicking the [Report] button at the bottom of the review and clearly state the reason(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff will review the report and decide what action to take.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to report fictions
rubrics_metrics.description: If you find that a fiction violates any of our rules, do not leave a review stating as such. Report the fiction by clicking the [Report] button on the top right of the story’s main page and clearly state the reason(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff will review reports of fiction-level violations and decide on actions.
